a0_flexural_limit.note: A0 phase velocity at kh=0.05 vs Kirchhoff limit kh*c_p/sqrt(3)

a0_rayleigh_limit.note: A0 phase velocity at kh=20 vs Rayleigh speed from the classical cubic

s0_rayleigh_limit.note: S0 phase velocity at kh=20 vs the Rayleigh speed c_R

root_residual.note: normalised Rayleigh--Lamb residual at every reported root

fem_phase_error_fine.note: max phase-velocity error of the 32x32 Floquet cell over kh=0.2..1

fem_convergence_order.note: order shortfall below 1.5 for the kh=0.2 mesh refinement (A0 and S0)

mass_conservation.note: sum of the consistent mass matrix vs 2*rho*L*2h (one block per translation)

rigid_mode_count.note: census of eigenvalues below 1e-6*omega_max at k=0; the Floquet cell owns two translation zeros (rotation is not Floquet-compatible); the band [2,3] admits the A0 branch's k=0 zero

limitations: uniform isotropic plate, plane strain, linear elastic, no damping
the periodic cell is a fixed physical length L=2h; kh<=1 keeps kL<2 and the lowest two discrete modes are the A0 and S0 branches
the coupled (free-surface) strip spectrum is the graded quantity; the u_x-only subsystem is not used as evidence
